summary: Bongiorno Group is a Melbourne practice (St Kilda Road, since 1964) serving medical and dental professionals across tax, accounting, planning, insurance and lending. Directors Mitchell McKeown and Ricky Caldow recorded a November 2026 Money Doctors episode on credit card surcharges and practice cashflow. The firm is individual-client oriented, so fit for close automation is weak.

hooks.text: Mitchell's November 2026 podcast on the card surcharge ban and practice cashflow gives a timely, specific opener about practice-owner finances.
The Payday Super episode shows the firm advises practice owners on payroll/super compliance, which ties to reconciliation load.
The firm has already publicly promoted digital bookkeeping and real-time data access to clients.

risks.text: Individual-client, wealth and tax oriented practice for doctors; no outsourced bookkeeping or close service listed, so fit is weak.
Primary contact Hannah Sheppard is an executive assistant, not a decision-maker; drafts go to director Mitchell McKeown instead.

gaps: No Xero/MYOB partner listing or tech stack mention found on the firm's own pages.
Only recruiter-posted job ads found (firm not named by itself), so not cited.
No Facebook/Instagram or news coverage found.
